title: A held lock keeps the gate shut
text: Three jobs wait in front of a gate. Taking a job puts a token in `lock`, and the inhibitor arc of `take` on `lock` keeps the gate shut until `release` empties `lock` again. The last step tries to take a second job while the lock is held: a job is waiting, but the inhibitor place is marked, so the transition is not enabled.

steps.text: The place `lock` is empty, so `take` fires and marks it.
The transition `release` empties `lock` and finishes the job.
The place `lock` is empty again: the second job is taken.
A job still waits, but `lock` holds a token.
